How to read ✕

Status

✓ActiveThe account can sign in. ⊘InactiveThe account cannot sign in.

Role

One role per user. What a role allows is on Roles & permissions.

Type

SystemProtected: cannot be renamed or deleted; its permissions can be edited, and Reset to default restores them. CustomMade here. Delete role moves its users to another role.

Permissions

Permissions are fixed by the product: a role is given some of them, none can be invented.

Data sources

OT data sources: MQTT broker connections consumed by the ingestion service.

State

✓ActiveThe ingestion service subscribes to it.○OffKept, not subscribed.

MODE map

counts as AUTOAUT, CAScounts as MANUALMAN, IMANNOT RECOGNISEDThe engine treats it as manual.

Levels

Site → Area → Unit → Device → Measurement. Path segments are permanent identity; names are labels.

Marks

CPMManaged by the CPM Loop Registry: the panel opens the loop.

Tag aliases

OT/legacy tag → canonical UNS path. Ingestion resolves incoming tag names through this table; a tag without an alias parks as unknown instead of flowing.

Next steps after saving

1. Click Test to verify the broker accepts these credentials
2. The ingestion runtime arrives in a later phase — active configurations take effect when it ships (question 10b: ingestion runs today)
3. Every OT tag the gateway publishes must be mapped in the asset model (alias mapping) before its data can land — records for unknown tags are parked, not auto-created
